Seven years ago, Jeffrey Epstein - the shadowy financier and pedophile
intimately linked to powerful people around the world, including Donald Trump
- died in jail. He was [found dead](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-
canada-49306032) in his jail cell at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in
New York City, where he was awaiting trial for federal sex trafficking
charges.

Questions surrounding Epstein and his legacy have
[dogged](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/epstein-files-reveal-close-
ties-to-trumps-influential-inner-circle) Trump, particularly throughout his
second presidency. Last year, due to significant public pressure, Congress
passed a law mandating the Justice Department
[release](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/4405) its
files related to Epstein. The Trump administration has been accused of slow-
walking and [covering up](https://www.merkley.senate.gov/massie-khanna-leger-
fernandez-merkley-lujan-introduce-the-epstein-files-transparency-act-ii/) the
release of the files, while members of its administration have
[refused](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/epstein-survivors-felt-
degraded-lack-empathy-ag-pam-bondi-rcna258633) to
[productively](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/epstein-
survivor-dani-bensky-meeting-todd-blanche-not-productive-rcna587936) meet with
Epstein's victims.

Epstein's death, which was ruled a suicide, would have
[possibly](https://www.foxnews.com/us/epstein-new-york-lockup-suicides) been
the first suicide in the Metropolitan Correctional Center in more than 20
years. That and many other puzzling questions and facts have left millions
wondering: _Did Jeffrey Epstein really commit suicide?_

The confluence __ of procedural failures and dubious events surrounding his
death has done nothing to quell suspicion. Here are eight unanswered questions
about Epstein's death:
